about.title: About Me
about.description: My name is Egor Zheludkov. I am a mobile and desktop developer. I started working in the IT industry in 2018 as a WPF developer. In early 2022, I transitioned to mobile development using Xamarin Native. Since the beginning of 2024, I've been working with Flutter. I am also the founder of a startup – Ovdix.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Experienced mobile and desktop developer with 6+ years in the IT industry. Specialized in cross-platform development using Flutter, Xamarin Native, and WPF. Proven track record of building high-quality applications and founding successful startup ventures. Passionate about creating innovative solutions and staying current with emerging technologies.
